title: Where All Debts Become One Stone

features.name: the-debt-rows
features.desc-on-touch: Each row is a layer. Each layer reads the debt above it and finds a different name for the same stone. The rows converge at a point where all meanings become weight.

features.name: the-convergence-fulcrum
features.desc-on-touch: Here the layers press together so tightly they become a single axis. All the debts—time-debt, land-debt, knowledge-debt—press down into one reading.

features.name: the-measurement-that-stops
features.desc-on-touch: A gauge that tried to measure each layer separately. But at this convergence, measurement ends. The needle jams at the point where all layers are one.

features.name: the-stratum-listen
features.desc-on-touch: Stone that learned to listen sideways through itself. Each layer a whisper the one below reads and answers. Convergence is not erasure—it's the moment when all voices finally understand each other.

features.name: the-pump-in-conversation
features.desc-on-touch: The pump stopped moving up and down. Now it moves sideways through the stone, reading debt as if debt were a current. The layers have taught it a new direction.

inscription: all debts resolve at the same depth; the convergence is not an answer but a weight that speaks in unison

file.name: Sediment_Cross_Reading_Phase7.txt
file.note: each stratum contradicts the one above it; the contradiction is the truth

reverie.title: REVERIE — in the red country at dusk, understanding how debt
narr: You kneel beside her in the red earth. She's holding soil in both hands.
Each layer in it—clay, silt, rust—tells a different story about the field.
'This earth has forgotten nothing,' she says. 'It's just stored it differe
You see: the archive doesn't resolve debts. It converges them,
makes them press together until pressure becomes a new kind of meaning.
The red dust on your hands is every contradiction made material.
